integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained once Wen's roof and metric and the standard conjugacy theorem for cohomologous positive roofs are fixed. No numerical experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to continuous cohomology over the same two-sided full shift. It does not characterize all roofs with local product structure and does not assert that cohomology to a Hölder roof is necessary.
title: A cohomological obstruction behind a non-Hölder suspension without local product structure
